description: Merge vertices closer than a tolerance into one (Blender's Mesh > Merge by Distance / bmo_remove_doubles / weld modifier). Spatial-hash bucketing for O(n); rebuild faces on the merged vertex set; drop faces that collapse to a degenerate (<3 distinct verts) after welding. Hardens boolean output and imported polygon soups before the CSG/polyMesh export bridges. New MeshOp::Weld { tolerance } variant + dispatch. V&V: coincident-duplicated cube welds 16->8 verts back to chi=2; a slit sphere seam welds to watertight; tolerance=0 is a no-op.
title: outram-blender: weld / remove-doubles (merge coincident vertices within tolerance)

description:
Publish deferred by the maintainer on 2026-07-28 in favour of shipping prebuilt binaries as GitHub release tags. Not attempted; nothing was published.

CORRECTED STATUS (an earlier version of this bead was wrong -- cargo info inside a workspace reports the LOCAL member, not crates.io, so it falsely showed everything as published; use cargo search for registry checks):

- outram-park-digital-twin-engine is NOT on crates.io at all. 0.1.0 is still free. The local bump to 0.2.0 (commit 174e837, unpushed) was made on the false premise that 0.1.0 was taken -- revisit the number if publishing later.
- Real blockers are unpublished PATH DEPENDENCIES, a 5-crate chain: outram-park-fork-dwsim-libs (dev-dep of the DT engine, real dep of tampines), tampines, njoy-outram-park-fork, nee_soon, then the DT engine itself. njoy and nee_soon are both required transitively (nee_soon -> njoy).
- Already published and fine: tuas_boussinesq_solver 0.1.4, chem-eng 0.1.0, teh-o-prke 0.1.2, tampines-steam-tables 0.2.4, outram-foam-basic-lib 0.1.0, outram-park-fork-coolprop 0.1.0, outram-foam-appbuilder-lib, outram-foam-turbulence-lib.
- NOT a blocker: package size. njoy packages to ~7 MiB against the 10 MiB limit because its Cargo.toml include list already excludes the >30 MB ENDF fixtures and the upstream_source git pack. The DT engine packages to 116 files with all six artwork files present (needed -- the GUI include_image!s them at compile time).
- Note before publishing nee_soon: workspace CLAUDE.md describes it as mostly scaffold. Publishing it publicly is a maintainer judgement call, not a mechanical step.
title: Publish CIET v2: crates.io release of outram-park-digital-twin-engine
